message.content: LiHua mentions that seeing a poster for a local music festival in their town presents an opportunity for the band to perform in front of an audience. Specifically, she notes, "Time: 20260617_17:00 LiHua: Did you see the poster saying that our town is holding a local music festival? It looks like it can be an opportunity for our band to perform in front of the crowd!" This opportunity is highlighted as a significant chance for the Jolly Band to showcase their music to a broader audience.
